// data/local-sources.js
// City wards and council districts. The Census doesn't publish these (every
// city draws its own), so they come from each city's open-data portal.
//
// TO ADD A CITY: add one entry to LOCAL_SOURCES below. That's it; the new
// layer appears automatically in the layer dock, the ballot tab and on the map.
//
// Entry fields
//   id        unique id, e.g. "boston-wards"
//   state     2-digit state FIPS ("25" = Massachusetts)
//   city      lowercase city name exactly as the Census spells it ("boston")
//   title     what to call it: "Ward", "City Council District"
//   type      "arcgis" (ArcGIS MapServer / FeatureServer layer) or
//             "socrata" (a Socrata `…/resource/<id>.geojson` dataset)
//   url       the layer URL (arcgis) or dataset .geojson URL (socrata)
//   field     the attribute holding the ward / district number or name
//   source    credit shown in the UI
//
// All entries below were checked to work from a browser (CORS) and to answer
// point-in-polygon queries.

export const LOCAL_SOURCES = [
  {
    id: "boston-wards",
    state: "25",
    city: "boston",
    title: "Ward",
    type: "arcgis",
    url: "https://gis.boston.gov/arcgis/rest/services/Planning/OpenData/MapServer/8",
    field: "WARD",
    source: "City of Boston Open Data",
  },
  {
    id: "boston-council",
    state: "25",
    city: "boston",
    title: "City Council District",
    type: "arcgis",
    url: "https://gis.boston.gov/arcgis/rest/services/Planning/OpenData/MapServer/4",
    field: "DISTRICT",
    source: "City of Boston Open Data",
  },
  {
    id: "chicago-wards",
    state: "17",
    city: "chicago",
    title: "Ward",
    type: "socrata",
    url: "https://data.cityofchicago.org/resource/p293-wvbd.geojson",
    field: "ward",
    source: "City of Chicago Data Portal",
  },
  {
    id: "nyc-council",
    state: "36",
    city: "new york",
    title: "City Council District",
    type: "socrata",
    url: "https://data.cityofnewyork.us/resource/872g-cjhh.geojson",
    field: "coundist",
    source: "NYC Open Data",
  },
];

const SIMPLIFY = 0.0004; // degrees; keeps downloads small

async function fetchJson(url) {
  const ctrl = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), 15000);
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, { signal: ctrl.signal });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
    return await res.json();
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
  }
}

// Returns { value, geometry } for the polygon covering the point, or null.
async function lookup(src, lng, lat) {
  if (src.type === "arcgis") {
    const url = new URL(`${src.url}/query`);
    const params = {
      geometry: `${lng},${lat}`,
      geometryType: "esriGeometryPoint",
      inSR: "4326",
      spatialRel: "esriSpatialRelIntersects",
      outFields: src.field,
      returnGeometry: "true",
      outSR: "4326",
      maxAllowableOffset: String(SIMPLIFY),
      f: "geojson",
    };
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(params)) url.searchParams.set(k, v);
    const data = await fetchJson(url.toString());
    const f = data.features?.[0];
    return f ? { value: f.properties[src.field], geometry: f.geometry } : null;
  }

  // Socrata: SoQL with a spatial filter + server-side simplification
  const url = new URL(src.url);
  url.searchParams.set(
    "$select",
    `${src.field}, simplify_preserve_topology(the_geom, ${SIMPLIFY}) as the_geom`
  );
  url.searchParams.set("$where", `intersects(the_geom, 'POINT (${lng} ${lat})')`);
  url.searchParams.set("$limit", "1");
  const data = await fetchJson(url.toString());
  const f = data.features?.[0];
  return f ? { value: f.properties[src.field], geometry: f.geometry } : null;
}

/**
 * Ward / council-district layers for the city at a point (may be empty).
 * @param {{name: string}} city  the "city" jurisdiction
 * @param {string} stateFips
 */
export async function findLocalLayers(city, stateFips, lng, lat) {
  const cityKey = String(city.name || "").trim().toLowerCase();
  const sources = LOCAL_SOURCES.filter((s) => s.state === stateFips && s.city === cityKey);
  const results = await Promise.all(
    sources.map(async (src) => {
      try {
        const hit = await lookup(src, lng, lat);
        if (!hit || hit.value == null || hit.value === "") return null;
        const value = String(hit.value);
        return {
          id: `ward:${src.id}:${value}`,
          kind: "ward",
          geoid: `${src.id}:${value}`,
          state: stateFips,
          name: `${src.title} ${value}`,
          short: `${src.title === "Ward" ? "Ward" : "Dist."} ${value}`,
          type: src.title,
          geometry: hit.geometry,
          center: [lng, lat],
          source: src.source,
        };
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn(`Local source ${src.id} failed:`, err);
        return null;
      }
    })
  );
  return results.filter(Boolean);
}

// js/candidate-sheet.js
// The candidate profile sheet: a slide-over panel with six tabs (In the News,
// Funding, Career, Issues, Sources, Myths & Facts).
//
// Ported from components/CandidateResearch.tsx (the React app) to plain DOM code
// so the static globe UI needs no build step. The data comes from
// data/candidates.js (which merges the Supabase seed data with the curated
// profiles). All text is inserted with textContent and links are validated with
// safeUrl(), exactly like the React version, so data can never inject markup.

import { getCandidate, initials } from "../data/candidates.js";

const TABS = [
  { id: "news", label: "In the News", icon: "📰" },
  { id: "funding", label: "Funding", icon: "💰" },
  { id: "career", label: "Career", icon: "🧭" },
  { id: "opinions", label: "Issues", icon: "🗣️" },
  { id: "sources", label: "Sources", icon: "🔗" },
  { id: "misconceptions", label: "Myths & Facts", icon: "🔍" },
];

const BIAS_LABELS = {
  nonpartisan: "Nonpartisan",
  center: "Center",
  "center-left": "Center-Left",
  "center-right": "Center-Right",
  left: "Left",
  right: "Right",
};

const TYPE_LABELS = {
  government: "Gov't record",
  nonprofit: "Nonprofit",
  factcheck: "Fact-checker",
  newspaper: "Newspaper",
  wire: "Wire service",
  academic: "Academic",
};

const STATUS_ICONS = { incumbent: "🏛️", running: "🗳️", former: "📋" };

// ----- Tiny DOM helper ------------------------------------------------------------

/** h("div", {class: "x", href: "..."}, child, "text", ...) */
function h(tag, attrs, ...children) {
  const el = document.createElement(tag);
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(attrs || {})) {
    if (v === false || v == null) continue;
    if (k === "class") el.className = v;
    else if (k === "text") el.textContent = v;
    else if (k.startsWith("on")) el.addEventListener(k.slice(2), v);
    else el.setAttribute(k, v === true ? "" : v);
  }
  for (const c of children.flat(Infinity)) {
    if (c == null || c === false) continue;
    el.append(c.nodeType ? c : document.createTextNode(String(c)));
  }
  return el;
}

/** Only http(s) links are rendered; anything else (e.g. javascript:) is dropped. */
function safeUrl(url) {
  return url && /^https?:\/\//i.test(url) ? url : undefined;
}

function link(href, text, cls) {
  const url = safeUrl(href);
  return url
    ? h("a", { href: url, class: cls, target: "_blank", rel: "noopener noreferrer" }, text)
    : h("span", { class: cls }, text);
}

const DATE_ONLY = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;
function formatDate(value) {
  if (!value) return null;
  const d = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(value);
  return d.toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
    year: "numeric",
    month: "short",
    day: "numeric",
    timeZone: DATE_ONLY.test(value) ? "UTC" : "America/New_York",
  });
}

function formatMoney(n) {
  if (n >= 1_000_000) return `$${(n / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M`;
  if (n >= 1_000) return `$${(n / 1_000).toFixed(0)}K`;
  return `$${n}`;
}

function alignmentLabel(score) {
  if (score >= 80) return { text: "Strongly supports", cls: "align-strong-yes" };
  if (score >= 60) return { text: "Leans in favor", cls: "align-yes" };
  if (score >= 41) return { text: "Mixed position", cls: "align-mixed" };
  if (score >= 21) return { text: "Leans against", cls: "align-no" };
  return { text: "Strongly opposed", cls: "align-strong-no" };
}

function voteClass(vote) {
  const v = String(vote).toLowerCase();
  if (["yes", "co-sponsor", "sponsored", "supported", "introduced"].includes(v)) return "vote-yes";
  if (v.startsWith("no")) return "vote-no";
  return "vote-neutral";
}

const timeOf = (value) => (value ? Date.parse(value) : Number.NaN);

/** Open on the freshest tab that has data. */
function defaultTab(c) {
  if (c.news) return "news";
  if (c.funding) return "funding";
  return "career";
}

// ----- The sheet ------------------------------------------------------------------

export class CandidateSheet {
  /**
   * @param {HTMLElement} root  the <aside> that holds the sheet
   * @param {{onClose?: () => void}} [handlers]
   */
  constructor(root, handlers = {}) {
    this.root = root;
    this.handlers = handlers;
    this.slug = null;
    this.tab = "news";
    this._returnFocus = null;
    root.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") this.close();
    });
  }

  get isOpen() {
    return !this.root.hidden;
  }

  /** Show a candidate. Returns false if we have no data for that slug. */
  open(slug, { focus = true } = {}) {
    const c = getCandidate(slug);
    if (!c) return false;
    if (!this.isOpen) this._returnFocus = document.activeElement;
    this.slug = slug;
    this.tab = defaultTab(c);
    this.root.hidden = false;
    document.body.classList.add("has-candidate");
    this._render(c);
    // Let the slide-in animation start from the hidden state. preventScroll
    // matters: focusing something inside a container that is still translated
    // off-screen would otherwise make the browser scroll the (overflow:hidden)
    // stage sideways to "reveal" it.
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      this.root.classList.add("is-open");
      if (focus) this.root.querySelector(".cs-close")?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    });
    this._setUrl(slug);
    return true;
  }

  close() {
    if (!this.isOpen) return;
    this.root.classList.remove("is-open");
    document.body.classList.remove("has-candidate");
    this.root.hidden = true;
    this.slug = null;
    this._setUrl(null);
    this._returnFocus?.focus?.();
    this._returnFocus = null;
    this.handlers.onClose?.();
  }

  // Make the profile shareable (?candidate=slug) without navigating.
  _setUrl(slug) {
    try {
      const url = new URL(window.location.href);
      if (slug) url.searchParams.set("candidate", slug);
      else url.searchParams.delete("candidate");
      window.history.replaceState(null, "", url);
    } catch {
      /* file:// or sandboxed: sharing links just won't update */
    }
  }

  _setTab(id, focusTab = false) {
    this.tab = id;
    for (const t of TABS) {
      const active = t.id === id;
      const btn = this.root.querySelector(`#cs-tab-${t.id}`);
      const panel = this.root.querySelector(`#cs-panel-${t.id}`);
      btn.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(active));
      btn.tabIndex = active ? 0 : -1;
      panel.hidden = !active;
    }
    if (focusTab) this.root.querySelector(`#cs-tab-${id}`).focus({ preventScroll: true });
    this.root.querySelector(".cs-scroll").scrollTop = 0;
  }

  _onTabKey(e) {
    const i = TABS.findIndex((t) => t.id === this.tab);
    let next = -1;
    if (e.key === "ArrowRight") next = (i + 1) % TABS.length;
    else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") next = (i - 1 + TABS.length) % TABS.length;
    else if (e.key === "Home") next = 0;
    else if (e.key === "End") next = TABS.length - 1;
    if (next < 0) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    this._setTab(TABS[next].id, true);
  }

  // ----- Rendering ---------------------------------------------------------------

  _render(c) {
    const panels = {
      news: () => this._news(c.news),
      funding: () => this._funding(c.funding),
      career: () => this._career(c),
      opinions: () => this._issues(c.opinions),
      sources: () => this._sources(c.sources, c.news),
      misconceptions: () => this._myths(c.misconceptions),
    };

    const tabs = h(
      "div",
      { class: "cs-tabs", role: "tablist", "aria-label": "Candidate information" },
      TABS.map((t) =>
        h(
          "button",
          {
            class: "cs-tab",
            type: "button",
            id: `cs-tab-${t.id}`,
            role: "tab",
            "aria-selected": String(t.id === this.tab),
            "aria-controls": `cs-panel-${t.id}`,
            tabindex: t.id === this.tab ? "0" : "-1",
            onclick: () => this._setTab(t.id),
            onkeydown: (e) => this._onTabKey(e),
          },
          h("span", { "aria-hidden": "true" }, t.icon),
          " ",
          t.label
        )
      )
    );

    const body = h(
      "div",
      { class: "cs-scroll" },
      TABS.map((t) =>
        h(
          "div",
          {
            class: "cs-panel",
            id: `cs-panel-${t.id}`,
            role: "tabpanel",
            "aria-labelledby": `cs-tab-${t.id}`,
            tabindex: "0",
            hidden: t.id !== this.tab,
          },
          panels[t.id]()
        )
      )
    );

    this.root.replaceChildren(
      h(
        "button",
        {
          class: "cs-close",
          type: "button",
          onclick: () => this.close(),
          "aria-label": `Close ${c.name}'s profile`,
        },
        h("span", { "aria-hidden": "true" }, "←"),
        " Back"
      ),
      this._header(c),
      tabs,
      body,
      h(
        "footer",
        { class: "cs-foot" },
        "Research profile from the Mapachusetts candidate database. News summaries are AI-generated from linked reporting. Always verify claims with the sources."
      )
    );
  }

  _header(c) {
    const party = String(c.party || "").trim().toLowerCase();
    const photo = safeUrl(c.photo);
    const avatar = h("div", { class: "cs-avatar", "data-party": party, "aria-hidden": photo ? null : "true" });
    if (photo) {
      const img = h("img", { src: photo, alt: `Official photo of ${c.name}`, referrerpolicy: "no-referrer" });
      // Fall back to party-colored initials if the portrait fails to load.
      img.addEventListener("error", () => {
        avatar.replaceChildren(document.createTextNode(initials(c.name)));
        avatar.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      });
      avatar.append(img);
    } else {
      avatar.textContent = initials(c.name);
    }

    return h(
      "header",
      { class: "cs-head" },
      avatar,
      h(
        "div",
        { class: "cs-meta" },
        h("h2", { class: "cs-name", text: c.name }),
        c.role && h("p", { class: "cs-role", text: c.role }),
        h(
          "div",
          { class: "cs-badges" },
          c.party && h("span", { class: "cs-party", "data-party": party, text: c.party }),
          c.status &&
            h("span", {
              class: "cs-status",
              "data-status-type": c.status.statusType,
              text: c.status.statusLabel,
            })
        ),
        c.status?.termInfo && h("p", { class: "cs-term", text: c.status.termInfo }),
        link(c.openSecretsUrl, "View on OpenSecrets ↗", "cs-extlink")
      )
    );
  }

  _empty(...content) {
    return h("p", { class: "cs-empty" }, ...content);
  }

  _plain(text) {
    return h("div", { class: "cs-box cs-plain" }, h("span", { class: "cs-box-label", text: "In plain English" }), h("p", { text }));
  }

  _why(text) {
    return h("div", { class: "cs-box cs-why" }, h("span", { class: "cs-box-label", text: "🔍 Why people are searching this" }), h("p", { text }));
  }

  // -- Tab: In the News ------------------------------------------------------------

  _news(news) {
    if (!news) return this._empty("No recent news coverage has been summarized for this candidate yet.");

    const numbers = new Set(news.citations.map((c) => c.n));
    const dated = news.citations
      .filter((c) => !Number.isNaN(timeOf(c.published_at)))
      .sort((a, b) => timeOf(a.published_at) - timeOf(b.published_at));
    const from = formatDate(dated[0]?.published_at);
    const to = formatDate(dated[dated.length - 1]?.published_at);
    const range = from && to ? (from === to ? ` from ${from}` : ` from ${from} to ${to}`) : "";
    const updated = formatDate(news.generated_at);

    const paragraphs = String(news.summary)
      .split(/\n\s*\n/)
      .map((p) => p.trim())
      .filter(Boolean)
      .map((p) => h("p", {}, citedText(p, numbers)));

    return [
      h("p", { class: "cs-disclaimer", text: `AI-generated summary of news coverage${range}. Verify claims using the linked sources.${updated ? ` Updated ${updated}.` : ""}` }),
      h("div", { class: "cs-summary" }, paragraphs),
      news.citations.length > 0 && h("h3", { class: "cs-sub", text: "Sources" }),
      news.citations.length > 0 &&
        h(
          "ol",
          { class: "cs-cites" },
          news.citations.map((c) => {
            const meta = [c.source, formatDate(c.published_at)].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
            return h(
              "li",
              { id: `cs-cite-${c.n}`, value: c.n },
              link(c.url, c.title),
              meta && h("span", { class: "cs-meta-inline", text: meta })
            );
          })
        ),
    ];
  }

  // -- Tab: Funding ----------------------------------------------------------------

  _bars(items, label) {
    if (!items.length) return null;
    const maxPct = Math.max(...items.map((s) => s.pct));
    return h(
      "ul",
      { class: "cs-bars", "aria-label": label },
      items.map((s) =>
        h(
          "li",
          {},
          h("div", { class: "cs-bar-label" }, h("span", { text: s.label }), h("span", { class: "cs-bar-amount", text: formatMoney(s.amount) })),
          h(
            "div",
            { class: "cs-bar-track", role: "img", "aria-label": `${s.label}: ${s.pct}% of top contributions` },
            h("div", { class: "cs-bar-fill", style: `width:${maxPct > 0 ? (s.pct / maxPct) * 100 : 0}%` })
          )
        )
      )
    );
  }

  _funding(f) {
    if (!f) {
      return this._empty(
        "Campaign finance data hasn't been added for this candidate yet. Federal filings are on ",
        link("https://www.fec.gov/data/", "FEC.gov"),
        " and ",
        link("https://www.opensecrets.org", "OpenSecrets"),
        "; Massachusetts state races are on ",
        link("https://www.ocpf.us", "OCPF"),
        "."
      );
    }
    const stat = (label, value) =>
      h("div", { class: "cs-stat" }, h("span", { class: "cs-stat-label", text: label }), h("span", { class: "cs-stat-value", text: value }));
    return [
      h("div", { class: "cs-stats" }, stat("Total raised", f.total), stat("Top industry", f.topIndustry), stat("Small donors (<$200)", f.smallDonorPct)),
      f.plainEnglish && this._plain(f.plainEnglish),
      f.whyItMatters && this._why(f.whyItMatters),
      h("h3", { class: "cs-sub", text: "Top funding sources by industry" }),
      this._bars(f.sources, "Top funding sources breakdown"),
      f.foreignSources.length > 0 && h("h3", { class: "cs-sub", text: "Foreign policy & tariff-related PAC contributions" }),
      f.foreignSources.length > 0 && this._bars(f.foreignSources, "Foreign policy funding breakdown"),
      h("p", { class: "cs-note" }, "Data sourced from ", link("https://www.opensecrets.org", "OpenSecrets.org"), ". Verify figures directly on their platform."),
    ];
  }

  // -- Tab: Career -----------------------------------------------------------------

  _statusCard(s) {
    return h(
      "div",
      { class: "cs-statuscard" },
      h(
        "div",
        { class: "cs-statuscard-top" },
        h("span", { class: "cs-status-icon", "aria-hidden": "true", text: STATUS_ICONS[s.statusType] || "📋" }),
        h("div", {}, h("div", { class: "cs-status-title", text: `${s.currentTitle} — ${s.state}` }), h("div", { class: "cs-status-term", text: s.termInfo })),
        h("span", { class: "cs-status", "data-status-type": s.statusType, text: s.statusLabel })
      ),
      h("div", { class: "cs-box cs-plain" }, h("span", { class: "cs-box-label", text: "What this means" }), h("p", { text: s.plainEnglish })),
      s.runningFor && h("p", { class: "cs-running" }, h("span", { class: "cs-box-label", text: "Running for" }), " ", h("strong", { text: s.runningFor })),
      (s.committees || []).length > 0 &&
        h("div", { class: "cs-committees" }, h("span", { class: "cs-box-label", text: "Committee assignments" }), h("ul", {}, s.committees.map((n) => h("li", { text: n }))))
    );
  }

  _career(c) {
    if (!c.bio && !c.status && c.career.length === 0) {
      return this._empty("Career history hasn't been added for this candidate yet.");
    }
    return [
      c.status && this._statusCard(c.status),
      c.bio && h("p", { class: "cs-bio", text: c.bio }),
      c.career.length > 0 && h("p", { class: "cs-intro", text: "Roles held in chronological order, most recent first." }),
      c.career.length > 0 &&
        h(
          "ol",
          { class: "cs-timeline", "aria-label": "Career timeline" },
          c.career.map((e) =>
            h(
              "li",
              {},
              h("div", { class: "cs-years", text: e.years }),
              h("div", { class: "cs-role-block" }, h("strong", { text: e.title }), e.org && h("em", { text: e.org }), e.description && h("p", { text: e.description }))
            )
          )
        ),
    ];
  }

  // -- Tab: Issues -----------------------------------------------------------------

  _subIssue(topicId, sub) {
    const score = typeof sub.alignment === "number" ? sub.alignment : null;
    const align = score === null ? null : alignmentLabel(score);
    const detailId = `cs-sub-${topicId}-${sub.id}`;

    const detail = h(
      "div",
      { class: "cs-sub-detail", id: detailId, hidden: true },
      sub.plainEnglish && this._plain(sub.plainEnglish),
      sub.whyItMatters && this._why(sub.whyItMatters),
      h("details", { class: "cs-deep" }, h("summary", { text: "Dig deeper" }), h("p", { text: sub.detail })),
      sub.voteRecord && sub.voteRecord.length > 0 && h("h4", { text: "Vote record" }),
      sub.voteRecord &&
        sub.voteRecord.length > 0 &&
        h(
          "ul",
          { class: "cs-votes" },
          sub.voteRecord.map((v) =>
            h("li", {}, h("span", { class: "cs-vote-year", text: v.year }), h("span", { class: "cs-vote-bill", text: v.bill }), h("span", { class: `cs-vote ${voteClass(v.vote)}`, text: v.vote }))
          )
        )
    );

    const chevron = h("span", { class: "cs-chevron", "aria-hidden": "true", text: "▾" });
    const toggle = h(
      "button",
      { class: "cs-sub-toggle", type: "button", "aria-expanded": "false", "aria-controls": detailId },
      h("span", { class: "cs-sub-top" }, h("span", { class: "cs-sub-label", text: sub.label }), chevron),
      align &&
        h(
          "span",
          { class: "cs-align" },
          h("span", { class: "cs-align-track", "aria-hidden": "true" }, h("span", { class: `cs-align-fill ${align.cls}`, style: `width:${score}%` })),
          h("span", { class: `cs-align-label ${align.cls}`, text: `${align.text} · ${score}%` })
        )
    );
    toggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const open = toggle.getAttribute("aria-expanded") !== "true";
      toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open));
      detail.hidden = !open;
      chevron.textContent = open ? "▴" : "▾";
    });
    return h("div", { class: "cs-subissue" }, toggle, detail);
  }

  _issues(opinions) {
    if (!opinions.length) {
      return this._empty("Issue positions and voting records haven't been compiled for this candidate yet. The In the News tab covers positions reported in recent coverage.");
    }
    return [
      h("p", { class: "cs-intro", text: "Expand any issue to read the candidate's position and voting record." }),
      opinions.map((topic) =>
        h(
          "section",
          { class: "cs-topic" },
          h(
            "div",
            { class: "cs-topic-head" },
            h("span", { "aria-hidden": "true", text: topic.icon }),
            h("h3", { text: topic.topic }),
            h("span", { class: "cs-topic-count", text: `${topic.subIssues.length} issue${topic.subIssues.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}` })
          ),
          topic.subIssues.map((s) => this._subIssue(topic.id, s))
        )
      ),
    ];
  }

  // -- Tab: Sources ----------------------------------------------------------------

  _sources(sources, news) {
    const cited = news ? news.citations : [];
    if (!sources.length && !cited.length) return this._empty("No research sources have been added for this candidate yet.");
    return [
      sources.length > 0
        ? [
            h(
              "p",
              { class: "cs-intro" },
              "Every claim in this profile draws from the sources below, from outlets across the political spectrum so you can cross-reference. Bias ratings come from ",
              link("https://adfontesmedia.com", "Ad Fontes Media"),
              " and ",
              link("https://www.allsides.com", "AllSides"),
              "."
            ),
            h(
              "ul",
              { class: "cs-sources", "aria-label": "Research sources" },
              sources.map((s) =>
                h(
                  "li",
                  {},
                  h(
                    "div",
                    { class: "cs-source-head" },
                    link(s.url, `${s.name} ↗`, "cs-source-name"),
                    h("div", { class: "cs-source-tags" }, h("span", { class: `cs-tag bias-${s.bias}`, text: BIAS_LABELS[s.bias] || s.bias }), h("span", { class: "cs-tag cs-tag-type", text: TYPE_LABELS[s.type] || s.type }))
                  ),
                  h("p", { text: s.description })
                )
              )
            ),
          ]
        : h("p", { class: "cs-intro", text: "These are the news articles behind the In the News summary. Curated research sources haven't been added for this candidate yet." }),
      cited.length > 0 && h("h3", { class: "cs-sub", text: "News articles cited in “In the News”" }),
      cited.length > 0 &&
        h(
          "ul",
          { class: "cs-sources", "aria-label": "News articles cited in the summary" },
          cited.map((c) =>
            h("li", {}, h("div", { class: "cs-source-head" }, link(c.url, `${c.title} ↗`, "cs-source-name")), h("p", { text: [c.source, formatDate(c.published_at)].filter(Boolean).join(" · ") }))
          )
        ),
    ];
  }

  // -- Tab: Myths & Facts ----------------------------------------------------------

  _myths(items) {
    if (!items.length) return this._empty("No common misconceptions have been documented for this candidate yet.");
    return [
      h("p", { class: "cs-intro", text: "The most widely shared misconceptions about this candidate, each addressed with verifiable facts and a primary source you can check yourself." }),
      items.map((m) =>
        h(
          "article",
          { class: "cs-myth" },
          h("div", { class: "cs-myth-cat", text: m.category }),
          h(
            "div",
            { class: "cs-myth-claim" },
            h("div", { class: "cs-myth-head" }, h("span", { "aria-hidden": "true", text: "✕" }), " Common claim"),
            h("p", { text: `“${m.myth}”` }),
            safeUrl(m.mythSourceUrl) && link(m.mythSourceUrl, `Where this claim comes from: ${m.mythSourceLabel || "source"} ↗`, "cs-myth-link")
          ),
          h(
            "div",
            { class: "cs-myth-reality" },
            h("div", { class: "cs-myth-head" }, h("span", { "aria-hidden": "true", text: "✓" }), " What the record shows"),
            h("p", { text: m.reality }),
            link(m.sourceUrl, `Verify this: ${m.sourceLabel} ↗`, "cs-myth-link")
          )
        )
      ),
    ];
  }
}

// Turn "[1]" markers whose number has a matching citation into links to it.
// Unknown markers stay plain text (ported from components/CitedText.tsx).
function citedText(text, validNumbers) {
  const nodes = [];
  const re = /\[(\d+)\]/g;
  let last = 0;
  let m;
  while ((m = re.exec(text)) !== null) {
    const n = Number(m[1]);
    if (!validNumbers.has(n)) continue;
    if (m.index > last) nodes.push(text.slice(last, m.index));
    const a = h("a", { href: `#cs-cite-${n}`, class: "cs-cite-ref", "aria-label": `Source ${n}`, text: `[${n}]` });

    nodes.push(h("sup", {}, a));
    last = m.index + m[0].length;
  }
  if (last < text.length) nodes.push(text.slice(last));
  return nodes;

// extra path-resolution config: `npm run ingest`.
import { createServerClient } from "./supabase/server";
import type { NewArticle } from "./types";

/**
 * Feeds to ingest. Add more RSS 2.0 URLs here and they will be
 * fetched and parsed on the next ingest run.
 */
const FEED_URLS: string[] = ["https://rss.politico.com/congress.xml"];

/** Max length of a stored snippet, in characters. */
const SNIPPET_MAX = 500;

/** A single parsed <item> from an RSS feed (raw, pre-mapping). */
interface RssItem {
  title: string | null;
  link: string | null;
  description: string | null;
  pubDate: string | null;
}

/**
 * Pull every `<item>...</item>` block out of a raw RSS document.
 * Uses a non-greedy match so adjacent items are kept separate.
 */
function extractItems(xml: string): string[] {
  const items: string[] = [];
  const re = /<item\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/item>/gi;
  let match: RegExpExecArray | null;
  while ((match = re.exec(xml)) !== null) {
    items.push(match[1]);
  }
  return items;
}

/**
 * Extract the inner text of the first `<tag>...</tag>` in a block.
 * Unwraps CDATA sections and returns a trimmed string, or null if absent.
 */
function extractTag(block: string, tag: string): string | null {
  const re = new RegExp(`<${tag}\\b[^>]*>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/${tag}>`, "i");
  const match = re.exec(block);
  if (!match) return null;

  let value = match[1];
  // Unwrap one or more CDATA wrappers, e.g. <![CDATA[ ... ]]>.
  const cdata = /<!\[CDATA\[([\s\S]*?)\]\]>/g;
  if (cdata.test(value)) {
    value = value.replace(cdata, "$1");
  }

  const trimmed = value.trim();
  return trimmed.length > 0 ? trimmed : null;
}

/** Decode the handful of HTML entities that commonly appear in RSS text. */
function decodeEntities(input: string): string {
  return input
    .replace(/</g, "<")
    .replace(/>/g, ">")
    .replace(/"/g, '"')
    .replace(/'/g, "'")
    .replace(/'/g, "'")
    // Ampersand last so earlier entities decode correctly.
    .replace(/&/g, "&");
}

/** Remove HTML tags, leaving plain text behind. */
function stripHtml(input: string): string {
  return input.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, "");
}

/**
 * Turn a raw RSS description into a clean plain-text snippet:
 * strip tags, decode entities, collapse whitespace, and truncate.
 */
function cleanSnippet(description: string | null): string | null {
  if (!description) return null;

  const text = decodeEntities(stripHtml(description))
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim();

  if (!text) return null;
  return text.length > SNIPPET_MAX ? text.slice(0, SNIPPET_MAX) : text;
}

/** Best-effort source label: the hostname of the feed URL. */
function sourceFromFeed(feedUrl: string): string | null {
  try {
    return new URL(feedUrl).hostname;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/** Parse a raw RSS document into its list of items. */
function parseFeed(xml: string): RssItem[] {
  return extractItems(xml).map((block) => ({
    title: extractTag(block, "title"),
    link: extractTag(block, "link"),
    description: extractTag(block, "description"),
    pubDate: extractTag(block, "pubDate"),
  }));
}

/**
 * Fetch and parse a single feed into NewArticle rows.
 * Items without a link or title are skipped.
 */
async function ingestFeed(feedUrl: string): Promise<NewArticle[]> {
  const res = await fetch(feedUrl);
  if (!res.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Fetch failed (${res.status}) for ${feedUrl}`);
  }

  const xml = await res.text();
  const source = sourceFromFeed(feedUrl);
  const rows: NewArticle[] = [];

  for (const item of parseFeed(xml)) {
    const url = item.link ? decodeEntities(item.link).trim() : null;
    const title = item.title ? decodeEntities(item.title).trim() : null;
    if (!url || !title) continue;

    rows.push({
      url,
      title,
      snippet: cleanSnippet(item.description),
      source,
      published_at: item.pubDate,
    });
  }

  return rows;
}

/** De-duplicate rows by url, keeping the first occurrence. */
function dedupeByUrl(rows: NewArticle[]): NewArticle[] {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const out: NewArticle[] = [];
  for (const row of rows) {
    if (seen.has(row.url)) continue;
    seen.add(row.url);
    out.push(row);
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * Fetch, parse, and upsert articles from every feed in FEED_URLS.
 *
 * Resilient by design: a feed that fails to fetch or parse is logged
 * and skipped so the remaining feeds still ingest. Rows are de-duplicated
 * by url before a single upsert (onConflict: "url") into the "articles" table.
 *
 * @returns the number of articles stored or updated.
 */
export async function ingestArticles(): Promise<number> {
  const collected: NewArticle[] = [];

  for (const feedUrl of FEED_URLS) {
    try {
      const rows = await ingestFeed(feedUrl);
      collected.push(...rows);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn(`Skipping feed ${feedUrl}:`, err);
    }
  }

  const rows = dedupeByUrl(collected);
  if (rows.length === 0) return 0;

  const supabase = createServerClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("articles")
    .upsert(rows, { onConflict: "url", ignoreDuplicates: false })
    .select("id");

  if (error) throw error;
  return data?.length ?? 0;
}

// Allow running directly: `npx tsx lib/ingest.ts` or via a wrapper script.
if (process.argv[1] && /ingest\.ts$/.test(process.argv[1])) {
  ingestArticles()
    .then((n) => {
      console.log(`Stored/updated ${n} articles.`);
      process.exit(0);
    })
    .catch((err) => {
      console.error("Ingest failed:", err);
      process.exit(1);
    });
}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Export the teammates' political data for the globe UI.

The candidate research app (Next.js + Supabase) keeps its data in two places:

  supabase/seed-data/*.json      politician + cited news summary (the same files
                                 that build supabase/news_seed.sql)
  lib/candidate-profiles.ts      hand-curated funding / issues / career / sources
                                 / myths / status, keyed by slug

The globe UI is a static site (no build step), so it can't import TypeScript or
query Supabase without keys. This script turns both sources into ONE plain
JavaScript module the browser can import directly:

  data/political-data.generated.js

Run it whenever those source files change:

  python3 scripts/export_candidates.py

Nothing in the generated file is edited by hand. Fix data in the source files,
then re-run this script.
"""

import json
import re
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
SEED_DIR = ROOT / "supabase" / "seed-data"
PROFILES_TS = ROOT / "lib" / "candidate-profiles.ts"
BUILD_SEED = ROOT / "supabase" / "build-news-seed.mjs"
OUT = ROOT / "data" / "political-data.generated.js"

CITATION_FIELDS = ("n", "title", "url", "source", "published_at")


def fail(msg):
    print(f"error: {msg}", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)


def model_label():
    """Reuse the label the Supabase seed builder stamps on its summaries."""
    m = re.search(r'MODEL_LABEL\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"', BUILD_SEED.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return m.group(1) if m else "Research summary"


def load_seed(generated_at):
    politicians, news = [], {}
    files = sorted(SEED_DIR.glob("*.json"))
    if not files:
        fail(f"no seed files found in {SEED_DIR}")
    label = model_label()
    for path in files:
        d = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        p = d["politician"]
        if not p.get("slug") or not p.get("name"):
            fail(f"{path.name}: politician.slug and name are required")
        politicians.append(p)
        citations = [{k: c.get(k) for k in CITATION_FIELDS} for c in d["citations"]]
        news[p["slug"]] = {
            "summary": d["summary"],
            "citations": citations,
            "article_count": len(citations),
            "model": label,
            "generated_at": generated_at,
        }
    return politicians, news


def load_profiles():
    """candidate-profiles.ts is plain object literals; only the import line and
    the type annotation on the export are TypeScript."""
    ts = PROFILES_TS.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    ts = re.sub(r"^import type [^;]+;\s*$", "", ts, flags=re.M)
    ts, n = re.subn(
        r"export const CANDIDATE_PROFILES\s*:\s*CandidateProfile\[\]\s*=",
        "export const CANDIDATE_PROFILES =",
        ts,
    )
    if n != 1:
        fail("could not find `export const CANDIDATE_PROFILES: CandidateProfile[] =` in candidate-profiles.ts")
    # Any other TypeScript-only syntax would break the browser import.
    for pattern, what in (
        (r"\bas (const|[A-Z]\w*)\b", "`as` cast"),
        (r"\bsatisfies\b", "`satisfies`"),
        (r"\binterface\b", "`interface`"),
    ):
        if re.search(pattern, ts):
            fail(f"candidate-profiles.ts uses TypeScript-only syntax ({what}); extend export_candidates.py")
    return ts.strip()


def main():
    generated_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
    politicians, news = load_seed(generated_at)
    profiles_js = load_profiles()

    parts = [
        "// GENERATED by scripts/export_candidates.py. DO NOT EDIT BY HAND.",
        "// Sources: supabase/seed-data/*.json and lib/candidate-profiles.ts",
        "// Refresh:  python3 scripts/export_candidates.py",
        "",
        f"export const GENERATED_AT = {json.dumps(generated_at)};",
        "",
        "// Politicians + cited news summaries (same content as supabase/news_seed.sql)",
        f"export const POLITICIANS = {json.dumps(politicians, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)};",
        "",
        f"export const NEWS_SUMMARIES = {json.dumps(news, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)};",
        "",
        "// Hand-curated research profiles (verbatim from lib/candidate-profiles.ts)",
        profiles_js,
        "",
    ]
    OUT.write_text("\n".join(parts), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"wrote {OUT.relative_to(ROOT)}  ({OUT.stat().st_size // 1024} KB)")

// Builds supabase/news_seed.sql from the researched JSON files in
// supabase/seed-data/. Validates each file first (JSON shape, citation
// numbering, every [n] resolves, every citation is used).
//
// Usage: node supabase/build-news-seed.mjs
import { readdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { dirname, join } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const here = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const dataDir = join(here, "seed-data");
const outFile = join(here, "news_seed.sql");
const MODEL_LABEL = "Kiro sub-agent research (news from Oct 10-24, 2026)";

/** Quote a value as a SQL string literal (or NULL). */
function lit(value) {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return "null";
  return `'${String(value).replace(/'/g, "''")}'`;
}

/** Throw with the file name attached if a check fails. */
function check(cond, file, msg) {
  if (!cond) throw new Error(`${file}: ${msg}`);
}

function validate(file, d) {
  const p = d.politician;
  check(p && p.slug && p.name, file, "politician.slug and name are required");
  check(Array.isArray(p.career_history), file, "career_history must be an array");
  check(typeof d.summary === "string" && d.summary.trim(), file, "summary is empty");
  check(Array.isArray(d.citations) && d.citations.length > 0, file, "no citations");

  d.citations.forEach((c, i) => {
    check(c.n === i + 1, file, `citation numbers must be 1..n in order (got ${c.n})`);
    check(/^https:\/\//.test(c.url), file, `citation ${c.n} has a non-https url`);
    check(c.title && c.source, file, `citation ${c.n} needs title and source`);
    check(
      /^2026-10-(1\d|2[0-4])$/.test(c.published_at ?? ""),
      file,
      `citation ${c.n} date ${c.published_at} is outside Oct 10-24, 2026`
    );
  });

  const cited = new Set([...d.summary.matchAll(/\[(\d+)\]/g)].map((m) => Number(m[1])));
  for (const n of cited) {
    check(n >= 1 && n <= d.citations.length, file, `summary cites [${n}] with no source`);
  }
  for (const c of d.citations) {
    check(cited.has(c.n), file, `citation ${c.n} is never referenced in the summary`);
  }
}

const files = readdirSync(dataDir).filter((f) => f.endsWith(".json")).sort();
const records = files.map((file) => {
  const data = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(dataDir, file), "utf8"));
  validate(file, data);
  return data;
});

const sql = [
  "-- GENERATED by supabase/build-news-seed.mjs. Do not edit by hand.",
  "-- Run AFTER supabase/schema.sql, in the Supabase SQL Editor.",
  "-- Stores only headlines, links, short paraphrased snippets and cited summaries.",
  "begin;",
  "",
];

// Articles are shared across candidates, so de-dupe by URL.
const articles = new Map();
for (const r of records) {
  for (const c of r.citations) {
    if (!articles.has(c.url)) articles.set(c.url, c);
  }
}

sql.push("-- Politicians");
for (const { politician: p } of records) {
  sql.push(
    `insert into public.politicians (slug, name, party, state, current_office, bio, career_history)
values (${lit(p.slug)}, ${lit(p.name)}, ${lit(p.party)}, ${lit(p.state)}, ${lit(p.current_office)}, ${lit(p.bio)}, ${lit(JSON.stringify(p.career_history))}::jsonb)
on conflict (slug) do update set
  name = excluded.name, party = excluded.party, state = excluded.state,
  current_office = excluded.current_office, bio = excluded.bio,
  career_history = excluded.career_history;`
  );
}

sql.push("", "-- Articles (headline, link, short snippet only)");
for (const c of articles.values()) {
  sql.push(
    `insert into public.articles (url, title, snippet, source, published_at)
values (${lit(c.url)}, ${lit(c.title)}, ${lit(c.snippet)}, ${lit(c.source)}, ${lit(c.published_at)})
on conflict (url) do nothing;`
  );
}

sql.push("", "-- Article <-> politician links");
for (const r of records) {
  for (const c of r.citations) {
    sql.push(
      `insert into public.article_politicians (article_id, politician_id)
select a.id, p.id from public.articles a, public.politicians p
where a.url = ${lit(c.url)} and p.slug = ${lit(r.politician.slug)}
on conflict do nothing;`
    );
  }
}

sql.push("", "-- Cited news summaries");
for (const r of records) {
  const citations = r.citations.map(({ n, title, url, source, published_at }) => ({
    n, title, url, source, published_at,
  }));
  sql.push(
    `insert into public.politician_news_summaries (politician_id, summary, citations, article_count, model, generated_at)
select p.id, ${lit(r.summary)}, ${lit(JSON.stringify(citations))}::jsonb, ${citations.length}, ${lit(MODEL_LABEL)}, now()
from public.politicians p where p.slug = ${lit(r.politician.slug)}
on conflict (politician_id) do update set
  summary = excluded.summary, citations = excluded.citations,
  article_count = excluded.article_count, model = excluded.model,
  generated_at = excluded.generated_at;`
  );
}

sql.push("", "commit;", "");
writeFileSync(outFile, sql.join("\n"), "utf8");

console.log(`Validated ${records.length} files: ${files.join(", ")}`);
console.log(`Unique articles: ${articles.size}`);
console.log(`Wrote ${outFile}`);

// js/search.js
// Search-as-you-type place picker (an accessible "combobox").
//
// - Type a place ("Medford, MA", "Sugar Land TX", "Paris") and pick a result.
// - Works with mouse, touch and keyboard (Up/Down, Enter, Escape).
// - Requests are debounced and cancelled when superseded, to be kind to the
//   shared public geocoder (see js/geocode.js).

import { searchPlaces } from "./geocode.js";
import { searchCandidates } from "../data/candidates.js";

const DEBOUNCE_MS = 300;

export class SearchBox {
  /**
   * @param {object} refs - { form, input, list, status }
   * @param {object} handlers - { onSelect(descriptor), onSelectCandidate(slug) }
   */
  constructor(refs, handlers = {}) {
    this.refs = refs;
    this.handlers = handlers;
    this.results = [];
    this.activeIndex = -1;
    this._timer = null;
    this._abort = null;
    this._seq = 0;

    const { form, input } = refs;

    input.addEventListener("input", () => this._onInput());
    input.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => this._onKeyDown(e));
    input.addEventListener("focus", () => {
      if (this.results.length) this._open();
    });

    form.addEventListener("submit", (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      this._submit();
    });

    // Close the list when clicking elsewhere.
    document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      if (!form.contains(e.target)) this._close();
    });
  }

  focus() {
    this.refs.input.focus();
  }

  setValue(text) {
    this.refs.input.value = text;
  }

  // ----- Input handling ----------------------------------------------------

  _onInput() {
    const q = this.refs.input.value.trim();
    clearTimeout(this._timer);
    if (this._abort) this._abort.abort();

    if (q.length < 2) {
      this.results = [];
      this._render();
      this._close();
      this._message("");
      return;
    }
    // Candidates are searched locally, so they appear instantly.
    this._candidates = candidateResults(q);
    if (this._candidates.length) {
      this.results = this._candidates;
      this.activeIndex = 0;
      this._render();
      this._open();
    }
    this._message("Searching…");
    this._timer = setTimeout(() => this._run(q), DEBOUNCE_MS);
  }

  async _run(q) {
    const seq = ++this._seq;
    this._abort = new AbortController();
    try {
      const places = await searchPlaces(q, this._abort.signal);
      if (seq !== this._seq) return; // a newer search is in flight
      const results = [...candidateResults(q), ...places];
      this.results = results;
      this.activeIndex = results.length ? 0 : -1;
      this._render();
      if (results.length) {
        this._open();
        this._message(
          `${results.length} suggestion${results.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Use the arrow keys and Enter to choose.`
        );
      } else {
        this._open();
        this._message("");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      if (err.name === "AbortError") return;
      if (seq !== this._seq) return;
      this.results = candidateResults(q);
      this._render(
        this.results.length
          ? null
          : "We couldn't reach the search service. Check your connection, or pick a place from the lists instead."
      );
      this._open();
      this._message("Place search is unavailable right now.");
    }
  }

  _onKeyDown(e) {
    if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (!this.results.length) return;
      this._open();
      this._setActive((this.activeIndex + 1) % this.results.length);
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (!this.results.length) return;
      this._setActive(
        (this.activeIndex - 1 + this.results.length) % this.results.length
      );
    } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
      this._close();
    }
  }

  // Enter / the Search button: pick the highlighted suggestion, or search now.
  async _submit() {
    clearTimeout(this._timer);
    const q = this.refs.input.value.trim();
    if (q.length < 2) {
      this._message("Type a city, county, state or country to search.");
      return;
    }
    if (this.results.length && this.activeIndex >= 0) {
      this._choose(this.results[this.activeIndex]);
      return;
    }
    // Nothing loaded yet (user typed fast and pressed Enter): fetch, then pick.
    this._message("Searching…");
    try {
      const cands = candidateResults(q);
      const results = [...cands, ...(await searchPlaces(q))];
      if (results.length) {
        this._choose(results[0]);
      } else {
        this.results = [];
        this._render();
        this._open();
      }
    } catch {
      this._render("We couldn't reach the search service. Try again in a moment.");
      this._open();
    }
  }

  _choose(desc) {
    this.refs.input.value = desc.kind === "candidate" ? desc.name : desc.label;
    this.results = [];
    this._render();
    this._close();
    this._message("");
    if (desc.kind === "candidate") this.handlers.onSelectCandidate?.(desc.slug);
    else this.handlers.onSelect?.(desc);
  }

  // ----- Rendering ---------------------------------------------------------

  _render(errorText) {
    const list = this.refs.list;
    list.innerHTML = "";
    if (errorText) {
      list.appendChild(emptyItem(errorText));
      return;
    }
    if (!this.results.length) {
      if (this.refs.input.value.trim().length >= 2) {
        list.appendChild(
          emptyItem(
            "No U.S. places or candidates found. Try a city and state, like “Sugar Land, TX”."
          )
        );
      }
      return;
    }
    this.results.forEach((r, i) => {
      const li = document.createElement("li");
      li.id = `search-opt-${i}`;
      li.setAttribute("role", "option");
      li.className = "search-option";
      li.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(i === this.activeIndex));

      const title = document.createElement("span");
      title.className = "search-option-title";
      title.textContent = r.name;

      const sub = document.createElement("span");
      sub.className = "search-option-sub";
      sub.textContent = r.kind === "candidate" ? r.subtitle : subtitle(r);
      if (r.kind === "candidate") li.classList.add("search-option-candidate");

      li.append(title, sub);
      li.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => e.preventDefault()); // keep input focus
      li.addEventListener("click", () => this._choose(r));
      list.appendChild(li);
    });
  }

  _setActive(i) {
    this.activeIndex = i;
    const opts = this.refs.list.querySelectorAll('[role="option"]');
    opts.forEach((o, idx) =>
      o.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(idx === i))
    );
    const active = opts[i];
    if (active) {
      this.refs.input.setAttribute("aria-activedescendant", active.id);
      active.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
    }
  }

  _open() {
    if (!this.refs.list.children.length) return;
    this.refs.list.hidden = false;
    this.refs.input.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
  }

  _close() {
    this.refs.list.hidden = true;
    this.refs.input.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
    this.refs.input.removeAttribute("aria-activedescendant");
  }

  // Polite screen-reader announcement (also visible as small helper text).
  _message(text) {
    this.refs.status.textContent = text;
  }
}

// Candidate rows for the dropdown: { kind: "candidate", slug, name, subtitle }.
function candidateResults(q) {
  return searchCandidates(q, 3).map((c) => ({
    kind: "candidate",
    slug: c.slug,
    name: c.name,
    subtitle: ["Candidate", [c.role, c.party].filter(Boolean).join(" · ")].filter(Boolean).join(" · "),
  }));
}

function emptyItem(text) {
  const li = document.createElement("li");
  li.className = "search-empty";
  li.textContent = text;
  return li;
}

// "Middlesex County, Massachusetts, United States" for a city result, etc.
function subtitle(r) {
  const parts = [];
  const add = (v) => v && !parts.includes(v) && parts.push(v);
  const kind = {
    city: "City / town",
    county: "County",
    state: "State",
    district: "District",
    locality: "Place",
  }[r.type];
  const county =
    r.county && r.countryCode === "US" && !/county|parish|borough/i.test(r.county)
      ? `${r.county} County`
      : r.county;
  if (r.type !== "city" && r.city && r.city !== r.name) add(r.city);
  if (r.type !== "county") add(county);
  if (r.type !== "state") add(r.state);
  return [kind, parts.join(", ")].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
}

// js/geocode.js
// Place search + reverse geocoding using Photon (https://photon.komoot.io), a
// free, key-less geocoder built on OpenStreetMap data that supports
// search-as-you-type.
//
// PRIVACY: what the user types in the search box, and (only when they press
// "Use my location") their coordinates, are sent to photon.komoot.io. Nothing
// else leaves the browser. If you self-host Photon or switch providers, change
// PHOTON_URL below and adapt `toDescriptor`.
//
// Fair use: the public instance is shared, so keep the debounce in search.js
// and don't hammer it. For production, self-host or use a paid provider.
//
// SCOPE: United States only. Searches are limited to a bounding box around the
// 50 states + DC, and results are also filtered by country code (the box
// overlaps Canada and Mexico). Widen both to support more countries.

const PHOTON_URL = "https://photon.komoot.io";

// minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat: covers the 50 states, including Alaska and Hawaii.
const US_BBOX = "-179.3,18.8,-66.8,71.6";

// Only return real places (not shops, airports, hospitals, ...).
const PLACE_LAYERS = ["city", "county", "state", "district", "locality"];

// Normalized shape the rest of the app uses:
//   { type, name, country, countryCode, state, county, city, lng, lat, extent, label }
function toDescriptor(feature) {
  const p = feature.properties || {};
  const [lng, lat] = feature.geometry.coordinates;
  // Photon's extent is [minLon, maxLat, maxLon, minLat]; convert to
  // [west, south, east, north].
  const extent = Array.isArray(p.extent)
    ? [p.extent[0], p.extent[3], p.extent[2], p.extent[1]]
    : null;
  const desc = {
    type: p.type || "locality",
    name: p.name || "",
    country: p.country || "",
    countryCode: (p.countrycode || "").toUpperCase(),
    state: p.state || "",
    county: p.county || "",
    city: p.city || "",
    lng,
    lat,
    extent,
  };
  desc.label = describe(desc);
  return desc;
}

// Human-friendly label such as "Medford, Middlesex County, Massachusetts, United States".
export function describe(d) {
  const county =
    d.county && d.countryCode === "US" && !/county|parish|borough/i.test(d.county)
      ? `${d.county} County`
      : d.county;
  const parts = [];
  const add = (v) => {
    if (v && !parts.includes(v)) parts.push(v);
  };
  add(d.name);
  if (d.type !== "city" || !d.county) add(d.city);
  if (d.type !== "county") add(county);
  if (d.type !== "state") add(d.state);
  // Everything is in the U.S., so only name the country when it isn't.
  if (d.countryCode !== "US" && d.type !== "country") add(d.country);
  return parts.join(", ");
}

function buildUrl(path, params) {
  const url = new URL(path, PHOTON_URL);
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(params)) {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) v.forEach((item) => url.searchParams.append(k, item));
    else url.searchParams.set(k, v);
  }
  return url.toString();
}

/**
 * Search for places matching free text, e.g. "Sugar Land, TX".
 * @param {string} query
 * @param {AbortSignal} [signal]
 * @returns {Promise<object[]>} descriptors, best match first
 */
export async function searchPlaces(query, signal) {
  const q = query.trim();
  if (q.length < 2) return [];
  const res = await fetch(
    buildUrl("/api/", {
      q,
      limit: 15, // fetch extra: some results are dropped by the U.S. filter
      lang: "en",
      bbox: US_BBOX,
      layer: PLACE_LAYERS,
    }),
    { signal }
  );
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Search failed (${res.status})`);
  const data = await res.json();

  const seen = new Set();
  const results = [];
  for (const f of data.features || []) {
    const d = toDescriptor(f);
    if (!d.name || d.countryCode !== "US") continue;
    const key = d.label.toLowerCase();
    if (seen.has(key)) continue; // Photon sometimes returns near-duplicates
    seen.add(key);
    results.push(d);
    if (results.length >= 6) break;
  }
  return results;
}

/**
 * Find the place at a coordinate (used by "Use my location").
 * @returns {Promise<object|null>}
 */
export async function reversePlace(lng, lat, signal) {
  const res = await fetch(
    buildUrl("/reverse", { lon: lng, lat, lang: "en", limit: 1 }),
    { signal }
  );
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Reverse lookup failed (${res.status})`);
  const data = await res.json();
  const feature = (data.features || [])[0];
  return feature ? toDescriptor(feature) : null;
}

// js/globe.js
// The 3D globe (MapLibre GL, globe projection) and everything drawn on it:
//
//   1. WORLD SHADING   the U.S. lit up, other countries greyed out
//   2. CHILD SHAPES    clickable outlines of every state / every county
//   3. STACK OUTLINES  glowing outlines of the layers of government at a place
//                      (city, county, school district, congressional district...)
//   4. PINS            cities, plus a "you are here" pin
//
// MapLibre v6 is an ES module, imported from the CDN (pin the version; bump on
// purpose). No API keys: basemap = OpenFreeMap, country shapes = MapLibre demo
// tiles, state/county/district shapes = U.S. Census Bureau (data/census.js).

import * as maplibregl from "https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@6.15.0/dist/maplibre-gl.mjs";
import { levelByKey } from "../data/levels.js";

// ----- Themes ------------------------------------------------------------------

const COUNTRIES_TILEJSON = "https://demotiles.maplibre.org/tiles/tiles.json";
const ACTIVE_COUNTRIES = ["USA"]; // ISO alpha-3. Everything else is greyed out.

// Atmosphere glow around the globe that fades away as you zoom in.
const ATMOSPHERE = ["interpolate", ["linear"], ["zoom"], 0, 1, 5, 1, 7, 0];

const THEMES = {
  night: {
    style: "https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/dark",
    background: "#0c1630", // land
    water: "#050a18",
    inactive: "#2b3552",
    inactiveOpacity: 0.92,
    active: "#38bdf8",
    activeOpacity: 0.24,
    outline: "#7dd3fc",
    kidsLine: "rgba(186, 230, 253, 0.5)",
    kidsFill: "rgba(186, 230, 253, 0.05)",
    label: "#e0f2fe",
    halo: "rgba(5, 10, 24, 0.95)",
    sky: { "sky-color": "#1d4ed8", "horizon-color": "#38bdf8", "atmosphere-blend": ATMOSPHERE },
  },
  day: {
    style: "https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/bright",
    background: null,
    water: null,
    inactive: "#6b7280",
    inactiveOpacity: 0.8,
    active: "#2563eb",
    activeOpacity: 0.28,
    outline: "#1d4ed8",
    kidsLine: "rgba(30, 58, 138, 0.55)",
    kidsFill: "rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.06)",
    label: "#0f172a",
    halo: "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92)",
    sky: { "sky-color": "#60a5fa", "horizon-color": "#bfdbfe", "atmosphere-blend": ATMOSPHERE },
  },
};

// Idle motion on the whole-world view: the globe slowly sways left and right
// around the U.S. (a sine wave: +/-35 degrees of longitude, ~30 s per cycle).
const SWAY_CENTER_LNG = -98;
const SWAY_AMPLITUDE_DEG = 35;
const SWAY_RAD_PER_SEC = (2 * Math.PI) / 30;

const EMPTY_FC = { type: "FeatureCollection", features: [] };

export class Globe {
  /**
   * @param {string} containerId
   * @param {object} handlers
   *   onPlaceClick(node)     a city pin was clicked
   *   onRegionClick(region)  a country was clicked while zoomed out
   *   onShapeClick(shape)    a state / county outline was clicked
   *   onZoom(zoom)           the zoom level changed
   * @param {"night"|"day"} [theme]
   */
  constructor(containerId, handlers = {}, theme = "night") {
    this.handlers = handlers;
    this.theme = theme;
    this._container = document.getElementById(containerId);
    this._markers = [];
    this._spinning = false;
    this._atGlobe = true;
    this._pad = { left: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0 }; // px covered by floating panels
    this._stackShapes = new Map(); // id -> Feature
    this._bounds = new Map(); // stack shape id -> [w, s, e, n]
    this._kids = EMPTY_FC;
    this._kidBounds = new Map(); // id -> [w, s, e, n]
    this._focusId = null;
    this._hoverId = null;

    this.map = new maplibregl.Map({
      container: containerId,
      style: THEMES[theme].style,
      center: [SWAY_CENTER_LNG, 30], // start looking at the U.S.
      zoom: this.worldZoom(),
      attributionControl: { compact: true },
      maxPitch: 60,
    });
    this.map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl({ visualizePitch: true }), "top-right");

    this._tip = new maplibregl.Popup({
      closeButton: false,
      closeOnClick: false,
      className: "shape-tip",
      offset: 14,
    });

    // Pause the idle sway whenever the user touches the globe.
    for (const evt of ["mousedown", "touchstart", "wheel"]) {
      this.map.on(evt, () => this.stopSpin());
    }

    this.ready = new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.map.on("style.load", () => {
        // setProjection must be called after the style loads.
        this.map.setProjection({ type: "globe" });
        this._applyTheme();
        this._installLayers();
        this._pushData();
        resolve();
      });
    });

    this.map.on("error", (e) => console.warn("Map error:", e?.error?.message || e));
    this.map.on("zoom", () => this.handlers.onZoom?.(this.map.getZoom()));
    this.map.on("click", (e) => this._onMapClick(e));
    this.map.on("mousemove", (e) => this._onMapHover(e));
  }

  // ===== Theme =================================================================

  setTheme(theme) {
    if (theme === this.theme || !THEMES[theme]) return;
    this.theme = theme;
    // setStyle wipes our layers; style.load fires again and re-installs them.
    // diff:false forces a clean reload. With the default "diff", MapLibre patches
    // the old style in place, never fires style.load (so our layers and the
    // globe projection are lost), and can reset the camera.
    this.map.setStyle(THEMES[theme].style, { diff: false });
  }

// data/races.js
// Factory helpers that build race objects. Keeping the shape in one place makes
// it easy to (a) keep sample data consistent and (b) see the target schema when
// wiring a real data source.
//
// Race shape (full reference in data/types.js):
//   id           unique-ish id for keys
//   office       the office being contested ("Governor of Texas", ...)
//   kind         WHICH LAYER OF GOVERNMENT decides it: a key of KINDS in
//                data/kinds.js ("country" | "state" | "congress" | "senate" |
//                "house" | "county" | "city" | "school" | "ward"). The ballot
//                tab groups races by this.
//   category     secondary grouping/icon: "executive" | "legislative" | "local" |
//                "education" | "measure"
//   term         "4 years" (optional)
//   electionDate "YYYY-MM-DD" of the next election, or null when it varies
//   candidates   [{ name, party }]
//   description  optional plain-language context
//
// ALL CANDIDATES BELOW ARE PLACEHOLDERS ("Candidate A"). Replace with real data
// from your data source (see data/civic.js).

export const MIDTERM_2026 = "2026-11-03"; // General Election Day, Nov 3 2026
export const PRESIDENTIAL_2028 = "2028-11-07"; // General Election Day, Nov 7 2028

let _seq = 0;
const uid = (prefix) => `${prefix}-${++_seq}`;

const TWO = (a, b, partyA = "Party 1", partyB = "Party 2") => [
  { name: a, party: partyA },
  { name: b, party: partyB },
];

export function presidentialRace() {
  return {
    id: uid("pres"),
    office: "President of the United States",
    kind: "country",
    category: "executive",
    term: "4 years",
    electionDate: PRESIDENTIAL_2028,
    candidates: TWO("Candidate A", "Candidate B"),
    description:
      "National election, next held in 2028. Applies to every U.S. location.",
  };
}

export function makeGovernorRace(stateName) {
  return {
    id: uid("gov"),
    office: `Governor of ${stateName}`,
    kind: "state",
    category: "executive",
    term: "4 years",
    electionDate: MIDTERM_2026,
    candidates: TWO("Candidate C", "Candidate D"),
    description: `Statewide executive race for ${stateName}.`,
  };
}

export function makeSenateRace(stateName) {
  return {
    id: uid("sen"),
    office: `U.S. Senator (${stateName})`,
    kind: "state",
    category: "legislative",
    term: "6 years",
    electionDate: MIDTERM_2026,
    candidates: TWO("Candidate E", "Candidate F"),
    description: `Represents all of ${stateName} in the U.S. Senate.`,
  };
}

// One race per U.S. House district. `districtCode` like "TX-22".
export function makeHouseRace(districtCode) {
  return {
    id: uid("house"),
    office: `U.S. House, District ${districtCode}`,
    kind: "congress",
    category: "legislative",
    term: "2 years",
    electionDate: MIDTERM_2026,
    candidates: TWO("Candidate G", "Candidate H"),
    description: `Represents congressional district ${districtCode} in Washington, D.C.`,
  };
}

// State legislature: `chamber` is "senate" or "house"; `districtName` is the
// district's name from the Census ("State Senate District 17").
export function makeStateLegislatorRace(chamber, districtName, stateName) {
  const upper = chamber === "senate";
  return {
    id: uid(upper ? "ssen" : "shouse"),
    office: `${upper ? "State Senator" : "State Representative"}, ${districtName}`,
    kind: chamber,
    category: "legislative",
    term: "varies by state",
    electionDate: null,
    candidates: TWO("Candidate P", "Candidate Q"),
    description: `Represents this district in the ${stateName} ${
      upper ? "Senate" : "House (lower chamber)"
    }. Terms and election years vary by state.`,
  };
}

export function makeCountyRace(office, countyName, description) {
  return {
    id: uid("county"),
    office,
    kind: "county",
    category: "local",
    term: "4 years",
    electionDate: MIDTERM_2026,
    candidates: TWO("Candidate N", "Candidate O"),
    description: description || `County-level office for ${countyName}.`,
  };
}

export function makeMayorRace(cityName) {
  return {
    id: uid("mayor"),
    office: `Mayor of ${cityName}`,
    kind: "city",
    category: "local",
    term: "varies",
    electionDate: null,
    candidates: TWO("Candidate I", "Candidate J", "Nonpartisan", "Nonpartisan"),
    description: `Head of the ${cityName} city government. Election dates vary by city.`,
  };
}

// School governing board. `boardName` examples: "Boston School Committee",
// "Fort Bend ISD Board of Trustees".
export function makeSchoolBoardRace(boardName, whatItGoverns) {
  return {
    id: uid("school"),
    office: boardName,
    kind: "school",
    category: "education",
    term: "varies",
    electionDate: null,
    candidates: [
      { name: "Candidate K", party: "Nonpartisan" },
      { name: "Candidate L", party: "Nonpartisan" },
      { name: "Candidate M", party: "Nonpartisan" },
    ],
    description: `Governs ${whatItGoverns || "the local public schools"}.`,
  };
}

// `kind` = the layer that votes on it (default "state").
export function makeBallotMeasure(title, scopeName, summary, kind = "state") {
  return {
    id: uid("measure"),
    office: title,
    kind,
    category: "measure",
    term: null,
    electionDate: MIDTERM_2026,
    candidates: [
      { name: "Yes", party: null },
      { name: "No", party: null },
    ],
    description: `${summary} (${scopeName}).`,
  };
}

// Visual metadata per category: used for the small tag on each race card.
export const CATEGORY_META = {
  executive: { label: "Executive", icon: "🏛️", color: "#2563eb" },
  legislative: { label: "Legislative", icon: "⚖️", color: "#7c3aed" },
  local: { label: "Local government", icon: "🏙️", color: "#0e7490" },
  education: { label: "Schools", icon: "🎓", color: "#15803d" },
  measure: { label: "Ballot question", icon: "🗳️", color: "#c2410c" },
};

// data/events.js
// Factory helpers for civic events (town halls, meetings, debates, voter
// registration drives, election days, ...).
//
// Event shape:
//   id          - unique-ish id
//   title       - short name
//   kind        - OPTIONAL layer of government that holds it (a key of KINDS in
//                 data/kinds.js, e.g. "city", "school", "congress"). If omitted,
//                 it is taken from the place the event is attached to.
//   type        - key of EVENT_TYPES below
//   start       - ISO 8601 date-time string (local time of the event)
//   end         - optional ISO string
//   venue       - where it happens ("City Hall, Council Chambers")
//   virtual     - true if it can be joined online
//   description - one or two plain-language sentences
//   url         - optional link for details / RSVP
//   source      - "sample" for mock data; real feeds should set their own name
//
// The sample events use dates RELATIVE TO TODAY (see daysFromNow) so a demo
// never shows a stale calendar. Real feeds should return real dates.
// Election Day events use the real general-election date.

export const EVENT_TYPES = {
  townhall: { label: "Town hall", icon: "🎤", color: "#b45309" },
  meeting: { label: "Public meeting", icon: "🏛️", color: "#1d4ed8" },
  debate: { label: "Debate / forum", icon: "💬", color: "#7c3aed" },
  voting: { label: "Voting", icon: "🗳️", color: "#be123c" },
  hearing: { label: "Public hearing", icon: "📣", color: "#0e7490" },
  community: { label: "Community", icon: "🤝", color: "#15803d" },
};

let _seq = 0;
const uid = () => `evt-${++_seq}`;

// ISO string for N days from today at the given local hour/minute.
export function daysFromNow(days, hour = 18, minute = 30) {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setDate(d.getDate() + days);
  d.setHours(hour, minute, 0, 0);
  return toLocalIso(d);
}

// Build an ISO-like local string without converting to UTC.
export function toLocalIso(d) {
  const p = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${p(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${p(d.getDate())}T${p(
    d.getHours()
  )}:${p(d.getMinutes())}:00`;
}

export function makeEvent(fields) {
  return {
    id: uid(),
    type: "meeting",
    virtual: false,
    source: "sample",
    ...fields,
  };
}

export function electionDayEvent(date = "2026-11-03", scopeLabel = "") {
  return makeEvent({
    title: `General Election Day${scopeLabel ? ` (${scopeLabel})` : ""}`,
    type: "voting",
    kind: "country",
    start: `${date}T07:00:00`,
    end: `${date}T20:00:00`,
    venue: "Your assigned polling place (check your local election office)",
    description:
      "Polls are open on Election Day. Hours vary by state, so confirm yours with your local election office.",
  });
}

import { getNewsSummaries } from "@/lib/articles";
import { CANDIDATE_PROFILES } from "@/lib/candidate-profiles";
import { getAllPoliticians } from "@/lib/politicians";
import type {
  CandidateProfile,
  CandidateView,
  CareerEntry,
  Politician,
  PoliticianNewsSummary,
  ProfileCareerEntry,
} from "@/lib/types";

/** Normalize a year range for matching ("2013–present" ≈ "2013-present"). */
function yearsKey(years: string): string {
  return years
    .replace(/[\u2012-\u2015]/g, "-")
    .replace(/\s+/g, "")
    .toLowerCase();
}

/** First 4-digit year in a period like "1990s-2004", for sorting. */
function startYear(period: string): number {
  const match = /\d{4}/.exec(period);
  return match ? Number(match[0]) : 0;
}

/** Display the same party label for curated and Supabase records. */
function normalizeParty(party: string | null | undefined): string {
  const value = (party ?? "").trim();
  return value.toLowerCase() === "democrat" ? "Democratic" : value;
}

/**
 * Supabase career rows → Career-tab entries, most recent first. Where a
 * curated profile has a role with the same years, its organization and
 * plain-English description are attached. Falls back to the curated career.
 */
function mergeCareer(
  dbCareer: CareerEntry[],
  profileCareer: ProfileCareerEntry[] = []
): ProfileCareerEntry[] {
  if (dbCareer.length === 0) return profileCareer;

  const byYears = new Map(profileCareer.map((e) => [yearsKey(e.years), e]));
  return [...dbCareer]
    .sort((a, b) => startYear(b.period) - startYear(a.period))
    .map((entry) => {
      const match = byYears.get(yearsKey(entry.period));
      return {
        years: entry.period,
        title: entry.role,
        org: match?.org ?? "",
        description: entry.notes ?? match?.description ?? "",
      };
    });
}

function fromProfileOnly(profile: CandidateProfile): CandidateView {
  return {
    slug: profile.slug,
    name: profile.name,
    role: profile.role,
    party: normalizeParty(profile.party),
    bio: null,
    photo: profile.photo ?? null,
    status: profile.status ?? null,
    openSecretsUrl: profile.openSecretsUrl ?? null,
    career: profile.career ?? [],
    funding: profile.funding ?? null,
    opinions: profile.opinions ?? [],
    sources: profile.sources ?? [],
    misconceptions: profile.misconceptions ?? [],
    news: null,
  };
}

function fromPolitician(
  p: Politician,
  profile: CandidateProfile | undefined,
  news: PoliticianNewsSummary | undefined
): CandidateView {
  const dbCareer = Array.isArray(p.career_history) ? p.career_history : [];
  return {
    slug: p.slug,
    name: p.name,
    role: p.current_office ?? profile?.role ?? "",
    party: normalizeParty(p.party ?? profile?.party),
    bio: p.bio,
    photo: profile?.photo ?? null,
    status: profile?.status ?? null,
    openSecretsUrl: profile?.openSecretsUrl ?? null,
    career: mergeCareer(dbCareer, profile?.career),
    funding: profile?.funding ?? null,
    opinions: profile?.opinions ?? [],
    sources: profile?.sources ?? [],
    misconceptions: profile?.misconceptions ?? [],
    news: news ?? null,
  };
}

/**
 * Every candidate the research UI can show: Supabase politicians (with their
 * cited news summaries) merged with curated profiles by slug. If Supabase is
 * unreachable, the curated profiles still render. Server-only.
 */
export async function getCandidates(): Promise<CandidateView[]> {
  const [politicians, summaries] = await Promise.all([
    getAllPoliticians().catch((err: unknown): Politician[] => {
      console.error("Could not load politicians from Supabase:", err);
      return [];
    }),
    getNewsSummaries().catch((err: unknown): PoliticianNewsSummary[] => {
      console.error("Could not load news summaries from Supabase:", err);
      return [];
    }),
  ]);

  const profiles = new Map(CANDIDATE_PROFILES.map((c) => [c.slug, c]));
  const newsByPolitician = new Map(summaries.map((s) => [s.politician_id, s]));

  const views = politicians.map((p) => {
    const profile = profiles.get(p.slug);
    profiles.delete(p.slug);
    return fromPolitician(p, profile, newsByPolitician.get(p.id));
  });

  // Curated profiles that don't have a Supabase row yet.
  for (const profile of profiles.values()) {
    views.push(fromProfileOnly(profile));
  }

  return views.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
}

import { createClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";

/**
 * Server-side Supabase client.
 *
 * Uses the service_role key, which bypasses Row Level Security.
 * NEVER import this into a client component or expose it to the browser.
 * It is only safe inside server components, route handlers, and server actions.
 */
export function createServerClient() {
  const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
  const serviceRoleKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;

  if (!url || !serviceRoleKey) {
    throw new Error(
      "Missing Supabase env vars. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY."
    );
  }

  return createClient(url, serviceRoleKey, {
    auth: { persistSession: false },
  });
}

import { createServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import type { Article, PoliticianNewsSummary } from "@/lib/types";

/** Fetch the most recent articles, newest first. */
export async function getArticles(limit = 50): Promise<Article[]> {
  const supabase = createServerClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("articles")
    .select("*")
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
    .limit(limit);

  if (error) throw error;
  return (data ?? []) as Article[];
}

/** All cached AI news summaries (at most one per politician). */
export async function getNewsSummaries(): Promise<PoliticianNewsSummary[]> {
  const supabase = createServerClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("politician_news_summaries")
    .select("*");

  if (error) throw error;
  return ((data ?? []) as PoliticianNewsSummary[]).map((row) => ({
    ...row,
    citations: Array.isArray(row.citations) ? row.citations : [],
  }));
}

/** All politicians, alphabetical. The research UI searches them client-side. */
export async function getAllPoliticians(): Promise<Politician[]> {
  const supabase = createServerClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("politicians")
    .select("*")
    .order("name", { ascending: true });

  if (error) throw error;
  return (data ?? []) as Politician[];
}
